neighbours.label: The preposition ('from', 'after') right after a passive process verb in a lab or industrial method (cultured from, refined from, evaluated after): the source or condition slot of a procedure, vs 'from'/'after' of motion, origin or everyday time
fire: The bacteria were isolated from wound swabs taken at the hospital.
Most commercial aluminium is extracted from bauxite by electrolysis.
Ethanol is produced from corn starch in large fermentation tanks.
The DNA was purified from blood samples using a standard kit.
Subjects were tested after a twelve-hour overnight fast.
Biogas is generated from food waste at the municipal plant.
The crystals were recovered from the solution by slow evaporation.
Volunteers were examined after two weeks of the new diet.
quiet: The nurses came back from the hospital late in the evening.
Most tourists in the town come from Germany or France.
She drove from Chicago to Denver in a single day.
He got a postcard from his aunt in Spain.
We went for a walk after a long dinner with friends.
The smell of bread drifted from the bakery across the street.
The cat jumped down from the shelf and ran away.
They watched a film after the kids went to bed.

predictions: 'from'/'after' after isolated/extracted/produced/tested reach 0.4-1.0; 'from'/'after' after walk/come/receive and everyday 'after' stay under 0.1.
notes: Card: ' from' x14 (cultured from, refined from, prepared from, converted from, mined from), ' after' x3 (evaluated after, checked after).
